{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace('$', '', regex=False).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

mean_revenue_completed"}
